# Plugin Check codes that are accepted for this plugin.
#
# One code per line. Everything in this file is passed to Plugin Check as
# --ignore-codes, so a code listed here is not reported at all and every other
# finding fails CI. Add a code only with a reason, and remove it once the code
# no longer applies. Note this covers the whole plugin, not one file, so prefer
# fixing a finding or suppressing it at the line with `phpcs:ignore`.

# The plugin name and slug contain "WooCommerce", and the readme title keeps
# "(formerly WooCommerce Shipping & Tax)". Neither can change.
trademarked_term
mismatched_plugin_name

# Legacy public names. The WC_Connect_* classes, their hooks, the WooCommerce
# globals and DONOTCACHEPAGE keep their names because code outside this plugin
# depends on them. New code is prefixed by review, not by this check.
WordPress.NamingConventions.PrefixAllGlobals.NonPrefixedClassFound
WordPress.NamingConventions.PrefixAllGlobals.NonPrefixedHooknameFound
WordPress.NamingConventions.PrefixAllGlobals.NonPrefixedVariableFound
WordPress.NamingConventions.PrefixAllGlobals.NonPrefixedConstantFound

# The plugin ships its own translation files in i18n/languages, so it still
# loads them itself.
PluginCheck.CodeAnalysis.DiscouragedFunctions.load_plugin_textdomainFound
